definitions.primaryMetric: First-response latency: from the caller's last audible word to the agent's first audible word, both measured acoustically from the call recording at one common observation point.
definitions.correlation: Pearson cross-correlation between the mono-mix recording window at the best alignment offset and a TTS reference render of the scripted opening (or its observed paraphrase variant). Measures how closely the recorded caller audio matches the synthetic reference; degraded by PSTN codec distortion, line noise, agent audio mixed into the caller channel, paraphrase variance beyond the rendered references, and resampling.
definitions.transcriptLatency: Deprecated diagnostic: gap between VAATT transcript timestamps (STT finalization events at the session clock), inflated by endpointing wait, STT finalization and webhook delivery. Reported only as a cross-check.
definitions.callerPathOffset: The difference between VAATT's audio-based measurement and a provider's own server-side first-audio timing, measured on matched calls. It is a bound on harness overhead common to all providers, not subtracted from results.

thresholds.correlationMinNote: Set to 0.6: only 1 of 264 calls falls below it; the cross-check by correlation band (see report) shows boundary agreement holds across the 0.6-1.0 range. Calls below the floor are excluded from latency samples and counted per provider.

retell.note: Retell API POST /v2/list-calls; latency.e2e.values[0] = first-turn end-to-end latency (user speech end to agent audio), matched to our runs by dial time. Measured offset: median 11 ms over 49 matched calls.

providerInternalTiming.vapi: not used - Vapi exposes LLM-output message timestamps, not first-audio timing; an offset derived from them would conflate their TTS with harness overhead.
